title: Environmental Associate Broker
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

**Who are we?**

Howden is a global insurance group that places people at the heart of everything it does, offering the best advice and care to clients around the world. Howden is employee-owned, which means decisions are made in the interests of clients and colleagues rather than external shareholders. With over 18,000 employees across more than 100 countries, Howden combines local expertise with the scale and resources of a global network. Howden’s success is built on the strength of its relationships, an entrepreneurial mindset, and a culture where employees share directly in the company’s achievements.

**Why work at Howden?**

At Howden, colleagues are encouraged to be themselves, to challenge convention, and to help shape the future of the business. Employee ownership means that everyone has a stake in Howden’s success, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and long-term thinking. Howden invests in its people through structured development, mentorship, and the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading experts across a broad range of specialties. Howden is committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where different perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

**What is the role?**

Howden is seeking an Environmental Associate Broker to support its Environmental practice. This role works alongside senior brokers and producers to place and manage environmental insurance programs for clients across industries including manufacturing, real estate, construction, energy, and waste management. The successful candidate will support new and renewal business through carrier marketing, policy analysis, and client service, while developing technical expertise in environmental risk and coverage.

**What will you be doing?**

*Marketing and Placement*

* Prepare and submit marketing submissions to environmental carriers for new and renewal business, including pollution liability, contractor’s pollution liability, site pollution liability, and environmental impairment liability coverages
* Support the negotiation of terms, conditions, and pricing with carrier partners
* Review policy forms, endorsements, and quotes for accuracy and completeness

*Account Management*

* Maintain and service an assigned book of environmental accounts, acting as a day-to-day point of contact for client inquiries
* Prepare renewal strategies, exposure summaries, and coverage comparisons in coordination with senior brokers
* Process policy changes, endorsements, and certificates of insurance

*Relationship Management*

* Build and maintain working relationships with carrier underwriters in the environmental insurance market
* Collaborate with claims, account management, and other internal teams to deliver a consistent client experience
* Support client meetings and renewal presentations as needed

*Technical Development*

* Develop and maintain working knowledge of environmental coverage lines, regulatory considerations (e.g., CERCLA, RCRA), and industry trends
* Stay current on environmental market conditions, carrier appetite, and emerging risk areas

**What are we looking for?**

* 1-3 years of experience in insurance brokerage, underwriting, or a related environmental/risk management field
* Familiarity with environmental insurance coverage lines is preferred but not required
* Active Property & Casualty insurance license, or willingness to obtain one within an agreed timeframe
* Strong analytical, organizational, and written/verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and competing deadlines
* Bachelor’s degree preferred

**Compensation and Benefits**

The expected base salary range for this role is $90,000-$100,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible to participate in a commission-based incentive program. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave
* Life and Disability insurance

**Our sustainability promise**

Howden is committed to operating sustainably and to supporting the communities in which it operates. The organization integrates environmental, social, and governance considerations into its business practices and encourages employee participation in sustainability initiatives.

**What do we offer in return?**
===============================

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

* Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
* We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
* We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

**Reasonable adjustments**
==========================

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours\\* or hybrid working\\*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

* Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

**ABOUT ADVANCED ENERGY**

Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

  

**WHY BE A PART OF ADVANCED ENERGY?**

Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best-in-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together.

  

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Director, Global Sustainability is responsible for leading the company’s global Sustainability, ESG, Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) strategy to drive business value, strengthen regulatory compliance, enhance stakeholder confidence, and advance the company’s sustainability ambitions.

  

Reporting to the VP, Global EHS and Sustainability and serving as a member of the EHS Leadership Team, this role provides strategic leadership for environmental sustainability, climate, ESG, responsible business practices, material compliance, and sustainability reporting across the global enterprise. The Director is accountable for developing and executing programs that reduce environmental impacts, manage sustainability-related risks, ensure compliance with evolving global regulations, and support the company’s long-term growth objectives.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the development and execution of the company’s global Sustainability and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) strategy, aligning environmental, social, and governance priorities with business objectives and long-term growth plans.
* Drive enterprise-wide sustainability programs covering climate, greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 1, 2, and 3), energy management, waste reduction, water stewardship, resource efficiency, pollution prevention, and biodiversity.
* Establish sustainability goals, roadmaps, performance metrics, and governance processes to drive measurable improvements and support corporate commitments.
* Lead ESG reporting, disclosures, and sustainability data governance, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and compliance with applicable reporting frameworks and regulatory requirements.
* Own the preparation and publication of the annual Sustainability Report and other external sustainability communications.
* Ensure compliance with global sustainability, environmental, climate, and financial disclosure regulations, proactively addressing emerging reporting obligations and stakeholder expectations.
* Lead the company’s response to customer sustainability, ESG, and responsible business requirements, strengthening customer confidence and supporting business growth.
* Serve as the executive lead for sustainability assessments, ratings, and disclosures, including CDP, RBA, SBTI, CARB, customer audits, and other stakeholder-driven evaluations.
* Ensure Material compliance with applicable regulations and customer requirements, Conflict Minerals, and other emerging substance and product compliance obligations.
* Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, and Legal teams to manage material compliance risks, customer declarations, due diligence programs, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Drive the company’s CSR agenda, including human rights, responsible sourcing, ethical business conduct, labor and working conditions, supply chain responsibility, and community engagement.
* Strengthen supplier sustainability and human rights due diligence programs to support responsible business practices and compliance with evolving global regulations.
* Monitor emerging sustainability risks, regulatory developments, industry trends, and stakeholder expectations, translating them into business strategies, risk mitigation plans, and actionable programs.
* Build sustainability capability across the organization by fostering leadership engagement, accountability, and integration of sustainability principles into everyday business practices.
  

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Location: Singapore (main) or any major AEI’s location
* Environment: Works in a standard office environment using general office equipment
* Regular international travel to support program deployment, stakeholder engagement, customer discussions, and sustainability initiatives
  

**SKILLS**

* Deep expertise in corporate sustainability, environmental management, ESG reporting, and climate-related programs.
* Strong knowledge of sustainability reporting frameworks and standards, including GRI, CDP, and relevant regulatory disclosure requirements.
* Demonstrated experience leading greenhouse gas management programs, including Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 emissions.
* Strong understanding of environmental management systems, resource efficiency, waste management, water stewardship, and biodiversity-related programs.
* Knowledge of global sustainability regulations and emerging reporting requirements affecting multinational organizations.
* Experience managing sustainability ratings, customer assessments, and responsible business programs.
* Leadership, influencing, and stakeholder management capabilities across executive, operational, and functional teams.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate sustainability objectives into measurable business value and competitive advantage.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities with experience leveraging sustainability data to drive decision-making and performance improvement.
  

**EXPERIENCE**

* 10+ years of experience in Sustainability, ESG, Environmental Management, EHS, or related disciplines within a global or multinational organization.
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing enterprise-wide sustainability, ESG, environmental, or climate programs.
* Demonstrated experience leading sustainability reporting, ESG disclosures, and external stakeholder engagements.
* Experience within manufacturing, industrial, electronics, semiconductor, medical technology, or other complex global operational environments preferred.
* Proven track record influencing senior executives and leading cross-functional transformation initiatives.
  

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Sustainability, Engineering, Business, or a related field required.
* Master's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.

title: Principal Environmental Consultant / Team Lead – Singapore
description:
About SLR Consulting & the Role
  
  
At SLR Consulting, we are problem solvers, innovators, and trusted advisors helping shape sustainable solutions worldwide. SLR comprises over 5,000+ staff across our global regions, with 35+ Practices covering Engineering & Design, Planning & Assessment Environmental Sciences, Earth Sciences and Advisory Services. In the Asia Pacific region (SLRAPAC), SLR has 1,200+ employees located throughout 24 offices.
  
  
At the heart of SLR is a collaborative 'One Team' approach, a supportive and accessible workplace culture, and opportunities to work alongside industry leaders while making a real impact.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Environmental Consultant to join and lead our team in Singapore as we continue to grow following Hydrobiology's integration into SLR. You'll join the same highly regarded local team, now backed by SLR's global network of environmental specialists, multidisciplinary expertise, and expanded technical capability.
  
  
This is an opportunity for an experienced environmental consultant and recognised industry leader combine technical excellence, team leadership and business growth in a role that will influence both project outcomes and the future direction of the Singapore practice. You'll lead complex and meaningful projects across Singapore and Southeast Asia, mentor and develop a talented team, and help expand our presence in a growing regional market.
  
  
We're seeking someone who is equally comfortable providing trusted technical advice to clients, leading multidisciplinary teams, and building strong commercial relationships. You'll work closely with colleagues across the region and globally, leveraging SLR's technical depth to deliver innovative solutions for clients across a broad range of sectors.
  
  
Building on the strong reputation and client relationships established through the integration of Hydrobiology into SLR, this role offers a unique opportunity to lead an established team while helping shape the next phase of growth across Singapore and Southeast Asia.
  
  
Main Tasks and Responsibilities
  
  
**Including, but not limited to:**  
Lead and develop the Singapore Environmental team, providing technical, commercial and people leadership to a high-performing consulting team.
  
  
Deliver and oversee complex environmental consulting projects across Singapore, ensuring technical excellence, commercial performance and client satisfaction.
  
  
Provide senior technical leadership in aquatic ecology, environmental impact assessment (EIA), environmental and social impact assessment (ESIA) and related environmental services.
  
  
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, building long-term relationships and providing strategic environmental and sustainability advice.
  
  
Develop and execute growth initiatives for the Singapore practice, while supporting broader business development opportunities across the Southeast Asian market.
  
  
Identify, pursue and secure new business opportunities, leading proposals, tenders and client engagement activities.
  
  
Mentor, coach and develop team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, safety and continuous professional growth.
  
  
Manage project resources, workloads and priorities to ensure successful project delivery and effective utilisation of the team.
  
  
Collaborate with regional and global technical specialists to deliver multidisciplinary solutions and expand service offerings for clients.
  
  
Represent the business externally through industry engagement, professional networks, conferences and client forums, strengthening the company's profile in Singapore and Southeast Asia.
  
  
Skills and Experience
  
  
Degree qualification in Environmental Science, Marine Biology, Freshwater Ecology, Hydrobiology, Environmental Engineering or a related discipline, with post graduate qualifications highly regarded.
  
  
Extensive environmental consulting experience, including significant experience delivering aquatic ecology, marine science or related environmental projects.
  
  
Demonstrated experience leading and developing technical teams, including mentoring, coaching, performance management and recruitment.
  
  
Strong technical expertise in one or more relevant disciplines including freshwater ecology, marine ecology, aquatic ecosystems, water quality or environmental assessment.
  
  
Proven projec t management capability, including project planning, commercial management, budgeting, quality assurance and risk management.
  
  
Experience developing and maintaining trusted client relationships across government, infrastructure, energy, resources, industrial or development sectors.
  
  
Demonstrated success in business development, including proposal preparation, opportunity identification and work winning.
  
  
Experience delivering EIAs, ESIAs and projects aligned with international standards such as IFC Performance Standards would be highly regarded.
  
  
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence clients, stakeholders and multidisciplinary project teams.
  
  
Experience working within Singapore and/or Southeast Asia, with an understanding of regional environmental regulatory frameworks and market dynamics.
  
  
Our Benefits
  
  
We are proud of our unique culture where we work together to collaborate on projects to get the best possible outcome for our clients. Whether you’re working in the office, from home or a mix of the two, we recognise that every person is different, and our benefits aim to ensure that we cater for all.
  
  
Next Steps
  
  
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted with gender diverse interview panels to the best of our ability. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
  
  
Unsolicited resumes from recruitment consultants will not be accepted. You must be part of the preferred supplier agreement list which is coordinated through our Talent Acquisition team.
  
  
If you are interested, kindly send your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and interest to Jaden Pine-Murphy at
  
  
jaden.pine-murphy@slrconsulting.com
  
  
.
  
  
OUR EXPERIENCE DIFFERENTIATES US
  
  
FROM OUR COMPETITORS.
  
  
Hydrobiology is an environmental consulting company offering integrated services in the physical, biological and chemical processes of environmental systems. Our focus is technical excellence and high scientific expertise in our fields of work. We have been active in Southeast Asia since the organisation was first established in the early 2000s. Singapore is our first regional operations base in Asia.
  
  
Hydrobiology has a long history of undertaking projects throughout south east Asia. We have experience with the extensive geographic and rich cultural diversity of the region, and have a deep understanding of high rainfall tropical ecosystems.
  
  
We offer technical skills to a range of industry sectors including mining, oil & gas, ports and harbours, and other industrial developments of various types. We apply our skills to both marine and freshwater systems, including estuarine and marine flora and fauna ecology, habitat mapping, water and sediment quality monitoring, biomonitoring, ecotoxicology, river management and developing and implementing risk assessment frameworks.
  
  
Hydrobiology has offices in Singapore, Brazil, Papua New Guinea and Australia. Our projects span the globe. Our Singapore team work across this portfolio. We are not a mega-corporation where you will be one of thousands of employees. We all know each other, and we all work together. With us you will have the opportunity to work with and learn from technical leads within Singapore and across all our offices. Our company offers industry-leading professional development opportunities and a genuine career pathway as a professional scientist. Our project list includes many of the most challenging, and interesting, projects and expeditions around the world, many of which are world renowned and set the standard in environmental monitoring and impact assessment.
